Building: Asian Art Museum (former Main Library), San Francisco (museum).
The front (−z) is the Larkin Street front, facing west across Civic Center Plaza to City Hall.
Footprint: 55 m along x by 106.5 m along z, centred on the origin.
Outline (from OpenStreetMap), [x, z] in metres, going round:
[[-27.5,-53.2],[2.6,-53.1],[27.5,-52.1],[27.5,40.1],[14.5,40.2],[14.5,53],[-11.6,53.2],[-11.7,16.6],[-15.9,16.6],[-15.9,9.3],[-25.7,9.2],[-25.5,-36.8],[-27.5,-36.8]]
Height: the highest point is 29 m above the ground.

3 photographs attached, in order:
  1. front three-quarter across the plaza: whole neoclassical facade with colonnade over a rusticated base and hipped roof, daylight
  2. corner three-quarter showing the front and long side elevation with arched windows and the hipped slate roof, daylight
  3. aerial from above looking down on the roof of the whole building and Civic Center plaza in front, daylight

Reply with the JSON object only.
